name: Who Am I: The Tale of Dorothy
source:
Can you imagine having other people live inside your head? The protagonist of this story, Dorothy Watson, is a 14-years-old girl who just started middle school. From the outside she looks like a normal teenager but she has scars and pains that most children don’t have. Dorothy experienced trauma as a child and developed dissociative identity disorder, commonly known as multiple personality disorder, which split her into several personalities.

Alice, who’s as innocent as a child but sees things that others cannot.
Gretel, whose blinding rage makes her wary of everyone.
Cindy, always positive and outgoing, who doesn’t really like Dorothy for being an introvert.

If you don’t help her, Dorothy might not be able to adjust to her new life.
Fortunately there’s still hope. You have the power to talk to the different personalities including Dorothy, when Dorothy is asleep. In her Dream Space, you can become the counsellor for Dorothy and the other kids. Use your power to integrate the split personalities into Dorothy.
But do be careful! The personalities are very sensitive to your questions and answers. One wrong answer can drive the wedge between you and them, tearing the kids apart beyond repair. Dorothy’s life is in your hands and your choices will have direct impact on her.
Remember only you can save Dorothy!

[From [url=https://onaemo-studio.itch.io/who-am-i-the-tale-of-dorothy] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你能想象有其他人住在你的脑海里吗？这个故事的主人公多萝西·沃森（Dorothy Watson）是一位刚上中学的14岁女孩。从外表上看，她就像一个正常的青少年，但她身上有大多数孩子没有的伤疤和疼痛。多萝西小时候经历过创伤，并患上了分离性身份障碍，通常被称为多重人格障碍，这使她分裂成多种人格。

像孩子一样天真的爱丽丝却能看到别人看不到的东西。
格蕾特的暴怒使她对每个人都保持警惕。
辛迪总是积极、外向，但她并不喜欢多萝西的内向性格。

如果你不帮助她，多萝西可能无法适应她的新生活。
幸运的是，仍有希望。当多萝西睡着时，你有能力与包括多萝西在内的不同人物交谈。在她的梦想空间里，你可以成为多萝西和其他孩子的辅导员。用你的力量将分裂的人格融入到多萝西身上。
但一定要小心！个性对你的问题和答案非常敏感。一个错误的答案可能会导致你和他们之间产生隔阂，让孩子们的感情破裂到无法修复的地步。多萝西的生命掌握在你的手中，你的选择将直接影响她。
请记住，只有你才能拯救多萝西！
